title: WHOISJORDAN shares a new track "WYA?"
htmlContent:
Talented rapper WHOISJORDAN releases a new single called "WYA?," a dope sound that you can only get from him. He has undeniable talent that is on full display from the production that sets the tone, a commanding flow that makes his presence felt, and his raw lyrics that command the ultimate respect to make this track stellar in every way. The rap performance is magic at every turn and is truly in tune with his artistry to make a record you can vibe and get away to.
